list.name: Train / Test Split & Lifecycle Markers
list.rawQuery: SELECT event_ts AS time, component || ': ' || event_type AS title, COALESCE(details::text, model_version) AS text FROM eonet_lifecycle_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) ORDER BY event_ts;

options.content:
### Model Quality & Champion/Challenger Evaluation
Real-time shadow scoring, signed error drift tracking (`> 0` overpredicting, `< 0` underpredicting), and win-rate governance across **Closed** & **Open** events.

| Event Lifecycle & Error Matrix | Rolling Drift & Split Markers | Live Cohort Win-Rate Governance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Compares **v1 (Baseline)**, **v2 (GBT)**, and **v3 (SparkXGBoost)** signed errors (`pred - actual`), selects the **Best Model**, and projects optimal close timestamps. | Tracks daily **MAE** curves across the vertical **Train / Test Split (`2026-11-27`)** annotation to detect post-cutoff drift. | Evaluates post-cutoff closed hazards & live open hazards—retaining **v1/v2** baselines while validating **v3 (SparkXGBoost)** in shadow mode. |

targets.rawSql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT record_id, MAX(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v1_baseline' THEN abs_error_hours END) AS e1, MAX(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v2_gbt' THEN abs_error_hours END) AS e2, MAX(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v3_xgboost' THEN abs_error_hours END) AS e3 FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE status = 'closed' AND abs_error_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY record_id), winners AS (SELECT CASE WHEN e3 < e2 AND e3 < e1 THEN 'SparkXGBRegressor v3 (Challenger)' WHEN e2 < e3 AND e2 < e1 THEN 'GBTRegressor v2 (Shadow)' WHEN e1 < e2 AND e1 < e3 THEN 'Baseline v1 (Champion)' ELSE 'Tie' END AS winner FROM per_event WHERE e1 IS NOT NULL AND e2 IS NOT NULL AND e3 IS NOT NULL) SELECT winner, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM winners GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT time_bucket('7 days', scored_at_utc) AS time, model_version || ' (' || data_split || ')' AS series, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 2) AS mae_hours FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE actual_duration_hours IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scored_at_utc) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Rolling MAE Error Line Graph: Train (Solid) vs. Test Split (Dashed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT category_id, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Actual Duration (h)", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v1_baseline' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v1 Predicted (h) - Baseline", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v2_gbt' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v2 Predicted (h) - GBT", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v3_xgboost' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v3 Predicted (h) - XGBoost" FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE status = 'closed' AND data_split = 'test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6;

panels.title: Predicted vs. Actual Duration by Category (Test Split)

targets.rawSql: WITH closed_eval AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.event_id) h.event_id AS "Event ID", COALESCE(s.title, h.event_id) AS "Hazard Title", h.category_id AS "Category", 'closed' AS "Status", MAX(h.pred_severity_tier) AS "Severity Tier", COALESCE(s.event_time_utc, h.scored_at_utc - (MAX(h.actual_duration_hours) * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AS "Opened (UTC)", h.scored_at_utc AS "Actual Close (UTC)", ROUND(MAX(h.actual_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Actual Dur (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v1 Pred (h)", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END) - MAX(h.actual_duration_hours))::numeric, 2) AS "v1 Error (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v2 Pred (h)", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END) - MAX(h.actual_duration_hours))::numeric, 2) AS "v2 Error (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v3 Pred (h)", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END) - MAX(h.actual_duration_hours))::numeric, 2) AS "v3 Error (h)", CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN h.abs_error_hours END) <= LEAST(MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN h.abs_error_hours END), MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN h.abs_error_hours END)) THEN 'XGB v3 (Challenger)' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN h.abs_error_hours END) < MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN h.abs_error_hours END) THEN 'GBT v2 (Shadow)' ELSE 'Baseline v1 (Champion)' END AS "Best Model", COALESCE(s.event_time_utc, h.scored_at_utc - (MAX(h.actual_duration_hours) * INTERVAL '1 hour')) + (LEAST(MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END), MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END), MAX(CASE WHEN h.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN h.pred_duration_hours END)) * INTERVAL '1 hour') AS "Best Predicted Close (UTC)" FROM eonet_prediction_history h LEFT JOIN eonet_events_stream s ON h.event_id = s.event_id WHERE h.status = 'closed' AND h.data_split = 'test' GROUP BY h.event_id, s.title, h.category_id, s.event_time_utc, h.scored_at_utc ORDER BY h.event_id, h.scored_at_utc DESC LIMIT 100), open_eval AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.event_id) p.event_id AS "Event ID", COALESCE(s.title, p.event_id) AS "Hazard Title", p.category_id AS "Category", 'open' AS "Status", MAX(p.pred_severity_tier) AS "Severity Tier", COALESCE(s.event_time_utc, p.predicted_at_utc - (MAX(p.elapsed_hours) * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AS "Opened (UTC)", NULL::timestamptz AS "Actual Close (UTC)", ROUND(MAX(p.elapsed_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Actual Dur (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version='v1_baseline' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v1 Pred (h)", NULL::numeric AS "v1 Error (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version='v2_gbt' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v2 Pred (h)", NULL::numeric AS "v2 Error (h)", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v3 Pred (h)", NULL::numeric AS "v3 Error (h)", 'XGB v3 (Challenger)' AS "Best Model", COALESCE(s.event_time_utc, p.predicted_at_utc - (MAX(p.elapsed_hours) * INTERVAL '1 hour')) + (MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version='v3_xgboost' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) * INTERVAL '1 hour') AS "Best Predicted Close (UTC)" FROM eonet_predictions p LEFT JOIN eonet_events_stream s ON p.event_id = s.event_id WHERE p.status = 'open' GROUP BY p.event_id, s.title, p.category_id, s.event_time_utc, p.predicted_at_utc ORDER BY p.event_id, p.predicted_at_utc DESC LIMIT 100) SELECT * FROM closed_eval UNION ALL SELECT * FROM open_eval ORDER BY "Opened (UTC)" DESC;
